第90章 琐碎温情，背后冷箭！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

今天林川没去震旦大楼。

他把车停在淮海路口。

车驶过梧桐树影，阳光落在车窗上。

林川低头看了一眼手机。

沈蔓发来消息。

“今天飞杭州，晚上回上海。你忙不忙？”

林川回：“不忙也得装忙。”

沈蔓很快回：“林总辛苦，记得按时吃饭。”

后面跟了一个笑脸。

林川看着屏幕，嘴角动了一下。

前世他最怕手机响。

催债，争吵，坏消息。

现在手机响，多半是有人问他吃没吃饭，项目规划，资金到账通知。

他把手机扣在腿边，车窗外的树影往后退。

半小时后，车进了虹桥别墅区。

这套六百平独栋已经完成基础收房，软装团队今天进场复核尺寸。

顾城介绍的设计师带着两名助理等在门口。

设计师姓严，三十多岁，穿黑色高领，头发梳得很认真。

他看见林川下车，停了半秒，立刻迎上来。

“林先生？”

“嗯。”

严设计师递上方案册。

“我们根据您之前的要求，做了三套方案。整体偏现代简洁，但保留部分中式元素。”

林川接过来，翻了几页。

“可以增加胡桃木和暖色灯光。”

“我母亲怕麻烦，厨房和洗衣房要简单。不要做那种看起来漂亮、用起来折腾的东西。”

“明白。”

林川继续往里走。

“妹妹以后周末会来住。二楼给她留一间书房，采光要好。电脑、书柜、衣帽间都要有，但别做成样板间。”

严设计师一边记，一边看林川。

他原本准备了不少展示效果的说辞，现在都没用上。

林川问得很细。

插座位置、储物空间、老人上下楼、厨房动线。

问的全是住进去以后会不会方便。

看完别墅，林川又让司机去南京西路。

他准备给林建国订一块表。

父亲一辈子在厂里干，手上不是机油就是老茧，没有买过什么贵重的东西。

林川想给他买一块。

店在商场一楼。

门面不大，装修安静。

林川进去时，两个店员正在接待一对中年夫妻。

另一个年轻店员抬头看了他一眼。

“先生，看表吗？”

“嗯，给父亲看一块。”

“林先生？”

林川抬头。

“你认识我？”

经理快步过来。

“上次上海优秀企业家表彰会，我在现场做品牌接待。您可能没注意我。”

年轻店员拿着表盒出来，听到这句话，手顿在半空。

林先生。

优秀企业家表彰会。

她后背立刻绷直。

经理接过表盒，亲自打开。

“给长辈的话，我建议看传承系列，薄一点，戴着舒服。太复杂的功能不实用。”

林川拿起一块看了看。

“这块。”

林川刷卡时，经理双手接过卡。

从表店出来，林川顺手去旁边买了两条围巾。

一条给母亲，一条给小冉。

Lin Chuan did not go to Aurora Building today.

He parked the car at the Huaihai intersection.

The car drove past the shadow of the sycamore trees, and the sun fell on the car window.

Lin Chuan lowered his head and glanced at his phone.

Shen Man sent a message.

"Fly to Hangzhou today and return to Shanghai in the evening. Are you busy?"

Lin Chuan replied: "You have to pretend to be busy even if you're not busy."

Shen Man quickly replied: "Mr. Lin, thank you for your hard work. Remember to eat on time."

Followed by a smiley face.

Lin Chuan looked at the screen and moved the corners of his mouth.

In his previous life, he was most afraid of his cell phone ringing.

Debt collections, arguments, bad news.

When his cell phone rings now, most people ask him whether he has eaten, project planning, and notification of fund arrival.

He held the phone next to his leg, and the shadows of the trees outside the car window receded.

Half an hour later, the car entered the Hongqiao villa area.

The basic closing of this 600-square-meter single-family house has been completed, and the soft decoration team came to the site today to review the dimensions.

The designer introduced by Gu Cheng was waiting at the door with two assistants.

The designer's surname is Yan. He is in his thirties. He wears a black turtleneck and has his hair carefully combed.

He saw Lin Chuan get out of the car, stopped for half a second, and immediately came up to meet him.

"Mr. Lin?"

"Yeah."

Designer Yan handed over the plan book.

"We have made three sets of plans based on your previous requirements. The overall design is modern and simple, but some Chinese elements are retained."

Lin Chuan took it and flipped through a few pages.

“Walnut wood and warm lighting could be added.”

"My mother was afraid of trouble. The kitchen and laundry room should be simple. Don't make things that look beautiful but are difficult to use."

"Understood."

Lin Chuan continued walking inside.

"My sister will come to live on weekends in the future. Leave her a study room on the second floor with good lighting. There should be a computer, bookcases, and a cloakroom, but don't make it a model room."

Designer Yan looked at Lin Chuan while taking notes.

He originally prepared a lot of rhetoric to demonstrate the effect, but now he has not used it.

Lin Chuan asked carefully.

Socket location, storage space, elderly people going up and downstairs, and kitchen circulation.

All I asked was whether it would be convenient after moving in.

After viewing the villa, Lin Chuan asked the driver to go to Nanjing West Road.

He was going to order a watch for Lin Jianguo.

My father worked in a factory all his life, and his hands were filled with motor oil or calluses. He never bought anything valuable.

Lin Chuan wanted to buy him a piece.

The store is on the first floor of the mall.

The facade is small and the decoration is quiet.

When Lin Chuan entered, two shop assistants were receiving a middle-aged couple.

Another young clerk looked up at him.

"Sir, would you like to see your watch?"

"Well, let's show dad a piece."

"Mr. Lin?"

Lin Chuan raised his head.

"You know me?"

The manager came quickly.

"Last time at the commendation meeting for outstanding entrepreneurs in Shanghai, I was on hand to do brand reception. You may not have noticed me."

The young clerk came out with the watch box. Hearing these words, his hands paused in the air.

Mr. Lin.

Outstanding Entrepreneur Recognition Meeting.

Her back immediately straightened.

The manager took the watch box and opened it himself.

"For elders, I recommend the Heritage Series, which is thinner and more comfortable to wear. Too complicated functions are not practical."

Lin Chuan picked up a piece and looked at it.

"This piece."

When Lin Chuan swiped his card, the manager took the card with both hands.

After coming out of the watch shop, Lin Chuan went to the side and bought two scarves.

One for mother and one for Xiaoran.
